Problem Statement:
Trim excess leading path separators

A URL with excess leading / (path-separator)s would cause urllib3 to attempt to reparse the request-uri as a full URI with a host and port. This bypasses that logic in ConnectionPool.urlopen by replacing these leading /s with just a single /.

Closes #6643

turns.reply:
I collapse excess leading slashes in the URL path in `PreparedRequest.prepare_url` (`src/requests/models.py`), so `http://example.com//foo/bar` now prepares as `http://example.com/foo/bar`. The change is submitted, with a 629-byte patch touching one file.

I checked this with a quick manual run of three URLs, which came out as expected. The URL-filtered pytest run had one error, in `test_proxy_error_on_bad_url`, which I did not investigate, so I haven't confirmed it is unrelated to this change.

The issue asks for the trim to happen in urllib3's `ConnectionPool.urlopen`, which is outside this repo. I trimmed in requests instead, so the URL reaching urllib3 no longer has the extra slashes.
